question:
The following sentence has been split into four segments. Identify the segment that contains a grammatical error.

(A) The children eagerly gathered / (B) around the storyteller, / (C) listening attentive as he spun tales / (D) of adventure and magic under the starry sky.
solution:
The correct answer is '1' i.e. C listening attentive.
